url.description: Instead of repo: the website of a project with no repository, described entirely by its fallback.

manifest.description: Path of the manifest in the repository. Default: generator.json, then generator-library.json, at the root.

fallback.description: A snapshot of the repository's manifest (collections with their entries inlined), used only when the repository cannot be read. Refresh with `npm run sync:fallbacks`.

overlay.description: A generator or collection manifest merged over what the repository publishes (overlay wins).

overlayOnly.description: Do not read the repository; use the overlay alone.
